data.llm_justification: The rule-based model underweights the severity of the TYPE_A sudden cliff trajectory combined with a -75% BL velocity collapse and zero hotlead activity — these three signals together indicate a sharp, recent deterioration in marketplace engagement that is not offset by the anomalous reply rate (which likely reflects a data artifact where replies exceed BLs received, suggesting stale or cross-period reply counting rather than genuine health). Despite green RAG status and decent clickstream activity, the absence of any hotlead conversion and the CQS below 60 mean the seller is increasingly invisible to high-intent buyers, making recovery without intervention unlikely.
llm_interactions: TYPE_A sudden cliff + -75% BL velocity collapse compound into an acute disengagement signal that the base score treats too leniently
Reply rate >100% (180%) is a data anomaly — replies exceed BLs received, suggesting it should not be treated as a genuine positive health signal
Zero hotleads despite 403 clickstream events indicates high browse-but-no-convert behavior, suggesting catalog or pricing issues amplifying churn risk
CQS 57 (below 60) suppresses organic BL flow, creating a self-reinforcing visibility death spiral alongside the BL velocity drop
Green+ RAG category conflicts with CQS <60 and zero hotleads, suggesting RAG may be lagging and not yet reflecting the recent cliff
